messages:
sana: Quick heads-up: I'm proposing an SLO-aware quota delegation flow so console owners can surface soft quotas driven by SLOs, not just static percent allocations. Thoughts?

alex: Love the idea. Biggest caveat: how do we avoid noisy oscillation when telemetry changes?

ben: we need a telemetry gating predicate + short cooldown. Also suggest an audit log that shows automated changes.

luca: UX question — in console, should automated adjustments live in a separate "SLO-driven overrides" section or be inline with manual overrides?

sana: prefer separate section with ability to pin manual override. Also want a "preview impact" button.

maria: API surface: propose adding field on FeatureConfig: "slo_override": { "enabled": true, "source": "latency_slo", "window_sec": 300, "cooldown_sec": 600, "max_adjust_pct": 20 }

alex: example sample:

```json
{
  "flag": "route_priority",
  "default_quota_pct": 30,
  "slo_override": {
    "enabled": true,
    "metric": "p99_latency_ms",
    "target": 200,
    "window_sec": 300,
    "cooldown_sec": 900,
    "max_adjust_pct": 15
  }
}
```

ben: ops concern: when override toggles, downstream routers need a graceful handoff. Suggest a tokenized change event with prev/next and a 30s drain window.

ops-bot: Deploy check: config-api v2 health ok — last deploy 1742099800, no errors.

luca: Console copy: need clear label "Auto-adjusted by SLO" + tooltip "Automatically tuned by SLO policy; click to view history". Also an audit timeline panel.

sana: Also think about opt-in per team vs org default. Maybe a cohort-level toggle.

alex: For rollout: start with dry-run mode in console that shows "would adjust" but doesn't change routing. Then 2-week small cohort (1% traffic), then wider.

ben: telemetry: map all change events to a new "slo_adjustments" metric with tags: flag, team, from_pct, to_pct, reason. Helps us detect oscillations.

maria: API debate: Should we expose raw metric hooks (p99) or only aggregated SLO decisions? If raw, risky for tenants. I vote only expose decisions and allow webhooks for signals.

sana: Agreed. Also add guardrail: never auto-decrease below a floor defined by owner.

luca: UX nit: in timeline, show "predicted latency" vs "observed" with small sparkline.

alex: Next steps: draft spec + API proto. Who can own the spec?

sana: I'll draft initial RFC. @ben can you write the op-handling and rollback playbook? @maria can draft the API shape?

ben: Yep, I'll take ops playbook.

maria: On it. I'll update API sketch by EOD tomorrow.

ops-bot: Reminder: config-api maintenance window 1742120000-1742123600 UTC.

alex: Thanks. If anyone wants to prototype a console mock, ping me.

sana: thanks all :heart:
